actions.chip: Button opens a dialog listing the source links already in that claim and the source ids on the control. Citations are not invented from the colour or the label.
actions.chip-empty: If a chip has no source id and the claim has no source link, the dialog says no source is attached.
actions.data-node: Choosing a pathway step scrolls to the matching text step. The coloured script map is not copied.
actions.data-close: I understand hides the notice it sits in. The notice stays in the HTML without JavaScript.
actions.form-submit: Submit does not send the form.
actions.figure: Each figure has an Open image button. The image dialog uses the shared modal, zoom, and optional pin.
